backlog.title: Phase D1 — Answer pinning (ANSWER-PIN-001 / FR-35, spec M9)
backlog.description:
A recorded answer owns the caret in every view and on every entry path; same-value commits are inert no-ops that only advance; FR-18 confirm fires only on an explicit different choice; ★ answered marker on the short-view question line. Only the unshipped remainder of the spec (de633b0) — everything else in the PRD diff already shipped through c7d44c0 (cite, don't rebuild). Non-goals: no config surface, no auto-submit/gate changes, no state-machine/rev/epoch/persistence changes.

UPDATE REQUIRED (PRD amendments 2026-10-05/06): BUG-001 (answer pinning re-ask amendment) narrows the FR-D9 no-op to settled statuses — a same-value commit on a REASKED question is a re-confirmation commit, not a no-op; BUG-003 (FR-18 closed-edit ripple) widens the FR-18 gate to different-value edits of CLOSED questions on the same seams. Both amend work owned by the completed P1.M1.T2; rework is tracked as new Planned subtasks under P1.M1.T2/T5/T6. The Complete status reflects the original scope only.

CONTRACT DEFINITION:

2. INPUT: the question record q with `answer?: { value, custom?: true, at }` (shape per architecture/answer-pinning-contract.md) and status ∈ {answered, submitted, closed, moot, withdrawn, re-asked}; displayOptions(q) ordering.

LOGIC: Implement FR-D8/FR-35 (spec h2.8/h3.5): when q.answer present (any status carrying an answer, moot keeps its dimmed answer): custom:true → options.length (✎ row); choice + option value → DISPLAY row of answer.value mapped through displayOptions order; value no longer in options → clamp to row 0 (NEVER the recommendation); type:"text" → 0. No answer → today's ★ preselect unchanged (display row of recommendation, clamp 0). R2 intact: ★ stays visible on its own row but never owns the caret when an answer exists. Tests: flip the ★-preselect-on-revisit rows in src/panel/short-view.test.ts; add the stale-value-clamps-to-row-0 test (★ recommendation present, answer.value absent from options). Mock nothing external — scripted vitest only (plan/001 AUTOMATION-POLICY).

5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on initialCursorIndex + rewrite the "WHY ★ AND PRESELECT COEXIST" comment block (short-view.ts ~22-28 and ~117-123) to state the pinning contract — rides with this work, no separate docs subtask.

tasks.title: FR-D9 — Inert same-value commits on the accept paths
tasks.description:
enter/digit on the already-recorded value is a state NO-OP (advance only): no ripple seam, no applyAnswer, no evaluateDependsOn, no maybeAutoSubmit, no answer.at rewrite; byte-identical write-in re-commits inert with buffer consumed; acceptFromDeep treats no-op as accept; FR-18 modal fires only on an explicit different choice.

UPDATE REQUIRED: BUG-001 (2026-10-05 re-ask amendment) narrows the no-op to SETTLED statuses (answered/submitted/closed) — a same-value commit on a REASKED question is a RE-CONFIRMATION commit (fresh answer.at, diff-invisible; may fire the auto-submit transition; writeInEnter twin is KIND-PRESERVING on custom). BUG-003 (2026-10-06) widens the FR-18 ripple gate to different-value edits of CLOSED questions on the same seams (explicit status list answered|submitted|closed, gate sits behind the same-value no-op). Rework = new Planned subtasks S4–S7 below.

subtasks.title: BUG-001 — acceptOptionIndex/digit: reasked same-value commit = RE-CONFIRMATION
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/003_f8af1c6f6c49/architecture/panel-ui-seams.md §Accept-paths — src/panel/actions.ts `acceptOptionIndex` + the digit path (post-P1 state: the P1.M1.T2.S1 same-value no-op precedes the confirmRippleEdit seam; locate by content, lines drifted). decisions.md §2026-10-05 answer pinning re-ask amendment (BUG-001): a rule-1 re-ask flips status to `reasked` while KEEPING the answer — the lifecycle marker, not the user, created that hybrid, so enter/digit on the kept value is a re-confirmation, not a no-op ('re-confirming the kept value IS keeping it').
2. INPUT: question with status `reasked` carrying its pre-re-ask `answer` (rule-1 same-options update keeps answers); proposed option value equal to `answer.value`.
3. LOGIC: Narrow the inert no-op to SETTLED statuses — `q.status ∈ {answered, submitted, closed}`. When status is `reasked` and the proposed value equals the recorded answer: RE-CONFIRMATION commit — re-mark answered(pending) with a fresh `answer.at` (diff-invisible: the answer signature is value+text only, never `at`), run the dependsOn moot recompute, and run maybeAutoSubmit with the transition commit context (may fire the auto-submit, letting the re-ask → re-confirm → settle → completion loop close). FR-18 different-value ripple unchanged; digit path inherits; the three-outcome signal routes re-confirmations as ACCEPTs for acceptFromDeep. Tests: enter on the kept value of a reasked question re-marks pending and can complete the interrogation (old wedge: question counted unanswered everywhere, ctrl+s said 'nothing to submit', completion permanently blocked unless the user changed their answer). Mock: none — scripted vitest.
4. OUTPUT: amended acceptOptionIndex no-op predicate (settled-only) consumed by the digit path and covered by P1.M1.T5.S3's flips.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on acceptOptionIndex stating the settled-vs-reasked split, citing BUG-001/ANSWER-PIN-001.

Buffer-consume semantics from P1.M1.T2.S2 otherwise unchanged. Tests: both kinds re-confirm; reasked write-in re-confirm can complete the loop. Mock: none — scripted vitest.
4. OUTPUT: amended writeInEnter; covered by P1.M1.T5.S3.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on writeInEnter stating the reasked exclusion + kind-preserving rule, citing BUG-001.

subtasks.title: BUG-003 — option/digit path: FR-18 gate widens to CLOSED edits
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: src/panel/actions.ts `acceptOptionIndex` confirmRippleEdit seam + digit path (locate by content; seam anchored by P1.M1.T2.S1's no-op). decisions.md §2026-10-06 closed-edit ripple (BUG-003, Q39=B extension): 'the ripple-confirm seam fires for different-value edits to CLOSED (archived) questions on the option-accept and digit paths — a closed question still carries its recorded answer (FR-2: answers editable even archived), so silently mooting its answered dependents was an unconfirmed invalidation of real user work'.
2. INPUT: question with status `closed` carrying `answer`; a DIFFERENT proposed value; dependsOn transitive closure hitting answered/submitted/closed victims.
3. LOGIC: The FR-18 confirmRippleEdit gate's trigger/victim form becomes the explicit status list `answered|submitted|closed` — NOT answer-presence (answer-presence would also capture the `reasked` hybrid from rule-1 re-asks and require exemptions that would break P1.M1.T2.S4's same-value re-confirm seam; the status list keeps that path seam-free by construction). Ordering is load-bearing: the same-value no-op (which already covers closed) runs BEFORE the gate, so same-value re-commits on closed stay inert (advance, no modal, no state write); zero-victim closed edits apply directly with no modal. digit path inherits. Tests: different-value closed edit raises the modal; same-value closed re-commit inert; zero-victim closed edit applies silently. Mock: none — scripted vitest.
4. OUTPUT: widened gate consumed on both option-accept paths; covered by P1.M1.T5.S3.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc at the seam citing BUG-003 and the status-list-not-answer-presence rule.

backlog.title: Phase D2 — Pinned deep-view question (DEEP-PIN-001)
backlog.description: The deep pane splits into two regions: a PINNED question region (moot reason line when moot, full description, full goal below it, dimmed) that NEVER scrolls, and a scrollable options region under it. Root cause (2026-10-05 owner report): the pre-pin single-scroll-pane layout let the sticky selection floor (offset ≥ headerIdx − viewportHeight + 2) strand the question above the window with no way back short of toggling the view. Rulings: scrollOffset indexes the OPTIONS region only; DeepContent grows a questionLines region rendered on every offset; question-region overflow truncates bottom-first (dimmed … marker, description priority over goal, ANSI-safe whole-line cut, never slicing styled lines); the options window never shrinks below MIN_OPTIONS_VIEWPORT (4 lines); text questions (no options region) let the question use the full pane height; the sticky-header clamp itself is unchanged but now operates inside the options region; render budget contract (pinned + window ≤ DEEP_VIEW_HEIGHT, every line width-bounded) holds. Non-goals: no changes to the D-R14 visual contract geometry (bar col 3, text col 4, amendment-8 trailing Title ★, variation-B separators, ▸/┃ selection glyphs), no short-view/overview changes, no state-machine changes.

backlog.title: Phase D3 — Guard & submit-pipeline bugfix pins (BUG-005, BUG-002 panel parity)
backlog.description: Two decisions.md bugfix pins from the PRD update. (1) BUG-005 (2026-10-07): 'guard-friendly first upserts' extends to epoch-carrying ones on a freshly swapped state — assertFresh accepts ANY sent epoch when the receiver is fresh (epoch 1, zero live questions) and the batch is all-new ids; the digest is provably empty ('(none)') so the mismatch signal carried no information. Deliberately scoped: all-new-id batches on NON-empty states still epoch-STALE (rotation guard, guards.test.ts 'epoch-only mismatch with only new ids'); the answers record path is untouched (a stale-epoch answers call is a true heal). Detected by invariant — NO new state field (serialize/hygiene pins forbid one). (2) BUG-002 panel parity (2026 wave 001_64331ded9ddb, D-R6 parity bullet): the panel ctrl+s submit honors the same flush rule — pending (answered) ids flush → submitted, synthesize card entries, bump the epoch, and deliver even when the answer-signature diff is empty (identical re-selection after a rule-2 re-ask); the zero-pending early return ('nothing to submit') is unchanged. Non-goals: no remote-bridge resurrection (surface removed 2026-10-02), no rev-guard changes, no UI changes.

backlog.title: Phase D4 — Moot reason persistence (BUG-004, Option A)
backlog.description: The moot reason (h2.29 `moot: {depId}={value}`) is PERSISTED on Question.mootReason at the evaluateDependsOn mute/still-moot site (Option A) rather than recomputed at render time (Option B REJECTED: dependencyMet render-time plumbing would force state into three public pure-renderer signatures — short-view mootReason, overview overviewMootReason, layout statusMarkers all stay pure Question-only readers). Rulings: (1) the field write is SILENT — never routed through setStatus/emitChanged — so still-moot passes stay zero-event and serialize byte-identical when the reason string is unchanged; a CHANGED reason on a still-moot question updates the field silently too; (2) a reason never outlives moot — both reopen branches (re-met; removed/emptied dependsOn, BUG-006b) clear the field BEFORE the setStatus flip, and merge rebuilds clear defensively; (3) renderers read the field first with legacy fallback chains intact and only while status === 'moot'; (4) the panel renders the reason VERBATIM with its 'moot: ' prefix — only buildCompletion strips the prefix for the record format; (5) buildCompletion keeps its recompute as the evaluator-truth cross-check (agreement test pins record reasons === persisted fields, prefix-stripped); (6) reconstruction step 5 re-runs evaluateDependsOn, so the field self-heals after restart. answerSignature is untouched. Non-goals: no new state fields beyond mootReason, no dependsOn semantics changes, no UI layout changes.
